_note: ONE move per station from knowledge/shot-vocabulary.md: hold | unroll | track | push | peek. Consecutive stations never share a move. Edit THIS file, then author-stations.py regenerates paths/st-<zone>-<station>.json. The hold is the default; push is for arrivals; peek is spent at most twice in the film.

the-stream-descent.why: the stream steps down across the frame; read it sideways

the-falls.why: the vertical axis of the scroll; the fall does the moving

the-great-pine.why: the pine is a near plane over the gorge -- the one multiplane moment in this zone

gorge-narrows.why: rise through the narrows, walls sliding past, no zoom

the-cliff-nose.why: the station author called it the deepest push in the film -- the arrival

the-hanging-canopy.why: big canopy and rust tree in a gust over empty air; sit and watch

the-red-maples.why: the colour runs along the left wall; read it edge to edge

upper-gorge-pines.why: already looking down on where we came from -- keep rising

the-fenced-path.why: the family's route; let the path sit under the narration
